question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Exactly the same words as were used originally.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"verbatim"** means using exactly the same words as were originally used; word for word. (शब्दशः)

 
 
• **Example: **She repeated the instructions verbatim to ensure there was no misunderstanding.
 
 
 
• **"Verbatim"** refers to something that is copied or repeated in exactly the same words as the original. (शब्दशः)
 
 
• **Example: **The witness's testimony was recorded verbatim in the court transcript.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Factual** (तथ्यात्मक): Based on or restricted to facts.

 
 
• **Example:** The report provided a factual summary of the events that took place.
 
 
 
• **Ornate** (सजीव): Made in an intricate shape or decorated with complex patterns.
 
 
• **Example:** The ornate architecture of the historic building attracted many tourists.
 
 
 
• **Precise** (सटीक): Marked by exactness and accuracy of expression or detail.
 
 
• **Example:** The instructions were precise, leaving no room for misunderstanding.
